entities.summary: Lobito is a municipality in Angola. It is located in Benguela Province, on the Atlantic Coast north of the Catumbela Estuary. The Lobito municipality had a population of 393,079 in 2014. Lobito is a city in Southern Africa, established around 1843. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 57 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
